title: Same planes, different channel order
purpose: Match adjacent and split-half pairing to an explicit permutation of projected channels.
contract: Adjacent pairs (0,1),(2,3); split-half pairs (0,2),(1,3) for R = 4.
Permuting both vectors and rotation consistently is equivalent; switching the mode alone is not.
